_doc: ENGINE_PLAN benchmark crop (engine/digitize/bench.py). Garment mm on the BK piece, size M: x from CB (+ = wearer's right), y from the CB neck seam. The requested crop (docs/ENGINE_PLAN.md) dipped below feather weight 0.6 of the back_left close-up along its bottom 5 mm (min 0.25), so it was shifted 5 mm up (min weight 0.647). Paths: relative to this project folder; a git-ignored build output that is missing here is looked up in the main checkout.
name: castle-bk-m

panel_labels.ref: 12 ppm reference (mockup + {closeup} close-up, min weight {min_weight}; source detail ~{source_ppm} px/mm)
panel_labels.part_map: part map: {parts} parts by kind (sky blue, falls white/blue, pool cyan, clouds white, strata in their thread colour, zone stubs in their thread colour washed grey); red tick = declared angle
panel_labels.live: live view (dstlive) - {stitches:,} stitches, {trims} trims ({trims_per_100cm2}/100 cm2 of covered area)
panel_labels.heat: direction (visible layer): {dir_ok}% OK, {dir_chaos}% chaotic, {n_dev} off-grain  [all stitches: {dir_all}%]
panel_labels.density: density mm/mm2: mean {dens_mean}, p95 {dens_p95}, {dens_flags} areas > {dens_thr} (white boxes)
panel_labels.legend: heat-map: green OK, red off the reference grain > 25 deg, magenta chaotic (R < 0.55); 8 mm tiles.   density ramp: navy 1, blue 2.5 (one tatami layer), green 5, yellow 7, red 9+ mm/mm2.   crop x {x0}..{x1}, y {y0}..{y1} mm ({piece}, size {size}, garment mm).   {label}  {date}

_doc_panel_labels: Panel titles (str.format over the gate row: closeup, min_weight, source_ppm, stitches, trims, trims_per_100cm2, dir_ok, dir_chaos, n_dev, dir_all, dens_mean, dens_p95, dens_flags, dens_thr, parts, x0..y1, piece, size, label, date). Read by digitize.panel.labels.
